--- title: "Seasonal space use" subtitle: "East Alligator" author: "Scott Forrest" date: "2026-11-06" execute: cache: false warning: false bibliography: paperpile.bib toc: true number-sections: false format: html: self-contained: false code-fold: true code-summary: "Show code" code-tools: true df-print: paged code-line-numbers: true code-overflow: scroll fig-format: png fig-dpi: 300 pdf: fig-format: png fig-dpi: 300 geometry: - top=30mm - left=30mm editor: source abstract: | Quantifying the space use of the pigs in East Alligator, and how that changes across seasons and for different months of the year. For estimating space use we are using 'occurrence' distributions, which are the probability of finding an animal in a given area at a given time. This is different to 'range' distributions, which are the probability of finding an animal in a given area over a long period of time (i.e. their home range). Occurrence distributions are more appropriate for short-term space use, such as across seasons and months. --- # Load packages ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(tidyverse) packages <- c("amt", "lubridate", "ctmm", "terra", "sf", "beepr", "tictoc", "leaflet", "viridis") walk(packages, require, character.only = T) # prevent scientific notation in outputs options(scipen = 999) ``` ::: # Create directories for outputs ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # general outputs directory outputs_dir <- "outputs/east_alligator/space_use/" dir.create(outputs_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE) ``` ::: # Import GPS tracking data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pig_all_steps <- read_csv("data/pigs_east_alligator_steps_covs_20261015.csv") # Convert timezone after import (resets to UTC) pig_all_steps <- pig_all_steps %>% mutate( t1_ = with_tz(t1_, tzone = "Australia/Darwin"), t2_ = with_tz(t2_, tzone = "Australia/Darwin") ) ``` ::: ## Get into format for ctmm ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # keep relevant columns pig_all <- pig_all_steps %>% dplyr::select(name, t1_, x1_, y1_, date, month, season) head(pig_all) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 6 x 7 name t1_ x1_ y1_ date month season 1 Betty 2025-10-10 09:00:15 -147080. -1423197. 2025-10-10 10 dry 2 Betty 2025-10-10 09:30:25 -146943. -1423458. 2025-10-10 10 dry 3 Betty 2025-10-10 10:00:27 -146926. -1423483. 2025-10-10 10 dry 4 Betty 2025-10-10 10:31:02 -146926. -1423447. 2025-10-10 10 dry 5 Betty 2025-10-10 11:00:14 -146905. -1423442. 2025-10-10 10 dry 6 Betty 2025-10-10 11:30:27 -146941. -1423462. 2025-10-10 10 dry ``` ::: ::: ## Select a subset of the data for prototyping ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pig_subset <- pig_all %>% filter(month == 11) # choose which dataset to use # pig_data <- pig_subset pig_data <- pig_all ``` ::: ## Convert to ctmm telemetry object ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # as.telemetry() identifies columns by their Movebank names, so we rename them. # x1_/y1_ are in GDA94 / GA Lambert (EPSG:3112), so convert to WGS84 lon/lat pig_data_movebank <- pig_data %>% filter(!is.na(x1_), !is.na(y1_), !is.na(t1_)) %>% st_as_sf(coords = c("x1_", "y1_"), crs = 3112, remove = FALSE) %>% st_transform(crs = 4326) %>% mutate(location.long = st_coordinates(.)[, 1], location.lat = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]) %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% transmute(ID = name, timestamp = t1_, location.long, location.lat, month, season) %>% as.data.frame() # returns a list of telemetry objects, one per individual pig_data_ctmm <- as.telemetry(pig_data_movebank, timezone = "Australia/Darwin", keep = c("month", "season")) ``` ::: # AKDE full tracking period ## Nest the telemetry objects One row per pig, with the telemetry object in a list column. The movement models and home ranges are then added as further list columns. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pigs_nested <- tibble(name = names(pig_data_ctmm), telemetry = pig_data_ctmm) pigs_nested ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 19 x 2 name telemetry 1 Betty 2 Bond 3 Brook 4 Chief 5 Collingwood 6 Dora the Explorer 7 Doris 8 Duane 9 Half Pint 10 Isaac 11 Johns 12 King David 13 Knocknee 14 Miss Piggy 15 Puncture 16 Razorback 17 Spot 18 The Big Mann 19 Unknown1 ``` ::: ::: ## Fit movement models and estimate home ranges Model selection is slow, so the results are saved and re-loaded if they already exist. Delete the file to re-fit. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hr_fits_file <- paste0(outputs_dir, "pigs_nested_akde.rds") if (file.exists(hr_fits_file)) { pigs_nested <- readRDS(hr_fits_file) } else { tic() pigs_nested <- pigs_nested %>% mutate( # automated model guesstimate guess = map(telemetry, ~ ctmm.guess(.x, interactive = FALSE)), # model selection (defaults to pHREML) fit = map2(telemetry, guess, ~ ctmm.select(.x, .y)), # area-corrected AKDE ud = map2(telemetry, fit, ~ akde(.x, .y, weights = TRUE)) ) toc() saveRDS(pigs_nested, hr_fits_file) beep(sound = 2) } ``` ::: ## Summarise the models and home range areas ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pigs_hr_summary <- pigs_nested %>% mutate( n_locations = map_int(telemetry, nrow), model = map_chr(fit, ~ summary(.x)$name), DOF_area = map_dbl(ud, ~ summary(.x)$DOF["area"]), # 95% home range area and CIs (units are reported in the column name) hr_area = map(ud, ~ { CI <- summary(.x)$CI tibble(units = rownames(CI), low = CI[1, "low"], est = CI[1, "est"], high = CI[1, "high"]) }) ) %>% dplyr::select(name, n_locations, model, DOF_area, hr_area) %>% unnest(hr_area) pigs_hr_summary ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` ![](space_use_monthly-mcp_east_alligator_files/figure-pdf/unnamed-chunk-9-19.png){fig-pos='H'} ::: ::: ## Convert to sf and save for QGIS `as.sf()` returns three polygons per pig for each contour level - the lower CI, the estimate and the upper CI. We extract the 50% (core area) and 95% (home range) contours. Each UD is in ctmm's own local projection, so they are all transformed to EPSG:3112 to match the rest of the data. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # home range contours to extract contour_levels <- c(0.5, 0.95) pigs_hr_sf <- pigs_nested %>% dplyr::select(name, ud) %>% # one row per pig per contour level crossing(level_ud = contour_levels) %>% mutate(hr_sf = map2(ud, level_ud, ~ as.sf(.x, level.UD = .y, level = 0.95) %>% st_transform(crs = 3112))) %>% dplyr::select(name, level_ud, hr_sf) %>% # as.sf already has a 'name' column (e.g. "Betty 95% est"), so rename it mutate(hr_sf = map(hr_sf, ~ rename(.x, contour = name))) %>% unnest(hr_sf) %>% mutate(ci = word(contour, -1)) %>% st_as_sf(crs = 3112) pigs_hr_sf ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Simple feature collection with 114 features and 4 fields Geometry type: GEOMETRY Dimension: XY Bounding box: xmin: -171581.3 ymin: -1440500 xmax: -138985.1 ymax: -1416327 Projected CRS: GDA94 / Geoscience Australia Lambert # i 104 more rows ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # a single GeoPackage with all pigs (filter on 'level_ud' and 'ci' in QGIS) st_write(pigs_hr_sf, paste0(outputs_dir, "pigs_hr_akde.gpkg"), delete_dsn = TRUE) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Deleting source `outputs/east_alligator/space_use/pigs_hr_akde.gpkg' using driver `GPKG' Writing layer `pigs_hr_akde' to data source `outputs/east_alligator/space_use/pigs_hr_akde.gpkg' using driver `GPKG' Writing 114 features with 4 fields and geometry type Unknown (any). ``` ::: ::: ### All pigs together ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pigs_hr_sf %>% filter(ci == "est") %>% ggplot() + geom_point(data = pig_data, aes(x = x1_, y = y1_, colour = name), alpha = 0.1, size = 0.25) + # point estimates of the 50% (dashed) and 95% (solid) contours geom_sf(aes(colour = name, linetype = factor(level_ud)), fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5) + scale_colour_viridis_d(guide = "none") + scale_linetype_manual("Contour", values = c("0.5" = "dashed", "0.95" = "solid"), labels = c("50%", "95%")) + coord_sf(datum = 3112) + labs(title = "50% and 95% AKDE home ranges", x = "", y = "") + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "right") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](space_use_monthly-mcp_east_alligator_files/figure-pdf/unnamed-chunk-11-1.png){fig-pos='H'} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggsave(paste0(outputs_dir, "pigs_hr_akde.png"), width = 150, height = 150, units = "mm", scale = 1.25, dpi = 600) ``` ::: ## Plot interactively with leaflet Each contour level is a separate layer that can be toggled in the layers control. The CIs and GPS fixes are hidden by default. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # reproject to WGS84 (EPSG:4326) for leaflet, and add the contour area pigs_hr_sf_wgs84 <- pigs_hr_sf %>% mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(.)) / 1e6) %>% st_transform(crs = 4326) %>% mutate(popup = paste0("ID: ", name, "
Contour: ", level_ud * 100, "% (", ci, ")", "
Area: ", round(area_km2, 2), " km2")) hr_50_est <- pigs_hr_sf_wgs84 %>% filter(level_ud == 0.5, ci == "est") hr_95_est <- pigs_hr_sf_wgs84 %>% filter(level_ud == 0.95, ci == "est") hr_95_ci <- pigs_hr_sf_wgs84 %>% filter(level_ud == 0.95, ci != "est") # GPS fixes (x1_/y1_ are in GDA94 / GA Lambert, EPSG:3112) pig_map_pts <- pig_data %>% filter(!is.na(x1_), !is.na(y1_)) %>% st_as_sf(coords = c("x1_", "y1_"), crs = 3112) %>% st_transform(crs = 4326) pal <- colorFactor(viridisLite::viridis(n_distinct(pigs_hr_sf_wgs84$name), option = "H"), domain = pigs_hr_sf_wgs84$name) hr_map <- leaflet(options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE)) %>% addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery) %>% addPolygons(data = hr_95_est, color = ~ pal(name), weight = 2, opacity = 1, fillColor = ~ pal(name), fillOpacity = 0.15, popup = ~ popup, highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 4, bringToFront = TRUE), group = "95% home range") %>% addPolygons(data = hr_50_est, color = ~ pal(name), weight = 2, opacity = 1, fillColor = ~ pal(name), fillOpacity = 0.35, popup = ~ popup, highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 4, bringToFront = TRUE), group = "50% core area") %>% addPolylines(data = hr_95_ci, color = ~ pal(name), weight = 1, opacity = 0.8, dashArray = "4 4", popup = ~ popup, group = "95% CIs") %>% # WebGL points, as there can be a lot of fixes leafgl::addGlPoints(data = pig_map_pts, fillColor = pal(pig_map_pts$name), fillOpacity = 0.75, radius = 4, popup = paste0("ID: ", pig_map_pts$name, "
Time: ", pig_map_pts$t1_), group = "GPS fixes") %>% addLegend(position = "bottomright", pal = pal, values = pigs_hr_sf_wgs84$name, title = "Pig ID") %>% addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft", options = scaleBarOptions(imperial = FALSE)) %>% addLayersControl(overlayGroups = c("95% home range", "50% core area", "95% CIs", "GPS fixes"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>% hideGroup(c("95% CIs", "GPS fixes")) # save a standalone copy to open in the browser (or share) htmlwidgets::saveWidget(hr_map, file.path(outputs_dir, "pigs_hr_akde_map.html"), selfcontained = TRUE) # Embedding the maps inline makes the rendered page (and its _freeze file) # too large for GitHub, so when rendering, the saved map is shown in an iframe # instead (_quarto.yml copies outputs/**/*.html into the site). When working # interactively the map is shown in the viewer as usual. embed_map <- function(map, filename, height = 600) { if (interactive()) return(map) htmltools::tags$iframe(src = paste0(outputs_dir, filename), width = "100%", height = height, style = "border: none;") } embed_map(hr_map, "pigs_hr_akde_map.html") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: # AKDE seasonal Here we estimate weighted AKDE home ranges separately for each season. Each season is kept separate by year (e.g. the 2025 dry season and the 2026 dry season), and the wet season spans the new year (e.g. the 2025-26 wet season). The model type of each pig (e.g. OUF anisotropic) is taken from the model selected for its full tracking period (`pigs_nested$fit`), so the same type is used for every season of a pig. The parameters are then re-estimated for each season. This matters because AKDE takes its effective sample size (and therefore its CIs) from the movement model, so using the full-period model directly would give each season the certainty of the whole tracking period, and CIs that are too narrow. The seasons are the same as in the data preparation and weather scripts: - Wet season: November - April - Early wet: November - January - Late wet: February - April - Dry season: May - October - Early dry: May - July - Late dry: August - October ## Settings ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # minimum number of days with fixes for a pig to be included in a season (~3 months) min_days_season <- 90 # and in a sub-season (~1.5 months) min_days_subseason <- 45 ``` ::: ## Functions These are used for both the seasons and the sub-seasons. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # season of each timestamp, labelled by year season_id <- function(t) { m <- month(t) y <- year(t) case_when( m %in% 5:10 ~ paste(y, "dry"), m %in% 11:12 ~ paste0(y, "-", sprintf("%02d", (y + 1) %% 100), " wet"), m %in% 1:4 ~ paste0(y - 1, "-", sprintf("%02d", y %% 100), " wet") ) } # sub-season of each timestamp, labelled by year subseason_id <- function(t) { m <- month(t) y <- year(t) case_when( m %in% 5:7 ~ paste(y, "early dry"), m %in% 8:10 ~ paste(y, "late dry"), m %in% 11:12 ~ paste0(y, "-", sprintf("%02d", (y + 1) %% 100), " early wet"), m == 1 ~ paste0(y - 1, "-", sprintf("%02d", y %% 100), " early wet"), m %in% 2:4 ~ paste(y, "late wet") ) } # split one pig's telemetry object into periods (seasons or sub-seasons). # Subsetting the telemetry object keeps its projection, so it matches the # full-period movement model. split_telemetry <- function(tel, period_fun) { t <- with_tz(tel$timestamp, tzone = "Australia/Darwin") periods <- period_fun(t) tibble(period = unique(periods)) %>% mutate(telemetry = map(period, ~ tel[periods == .x, ]), start = map_vec(period, ~ min(t[periods == .x])), n_fixes = map_int(telemetry, nrow), n_days = map_int(period, ~ n_distinct(as_date(t[periods == .x])))) } # fit the movement model to one pig-period and estimate the weighted AKDE. # The guess takes the model type from pig_fit (the full-period model), and its # parameters as starting values, which are then re-estimated from the period's data fit_period_akde <- function(tel, pig_fit) { guess <- ctmm.guess(tel, CTMM = pig_fit, interactive = FALSE) fit <- ctmm.fit(tel, guess, method = "pHREML") list(fit = fit, ud = akde(tel, fit, weights = TRUE)) } # one row per pig per period, with the period's movement model and weighted # AKDE. This runs in parallel, and the results are saved and re-loaded if they # already exist (delete the file to re-run). period_akde <- function(pigs_nested, period_fun, min_days, file) { if (file.exists(file)) return(readRDS(file)) pig_periods <- pigs_nested %>% dplyr::select(name, telemetry, pig_fit = fit) %>% mutate(periods = map(telemetry, ~ split_telemetry(.x, period_fun))) %>% dplyr::select(-telemetry) %>% unnest(periods) %>% filter(n_days >= min_days) tic() future::plan(future::multisession, workers = max(1, parallelly::availableCores() - 2)) results <- furrr::future_map2( pig_periods$telemetry, pig_periods$pig_fit, # a failed fit returns NULL rather than stopping the whole loop possibly(fit_period_akde, otherwise = NULL), .options = furrr::furrr_options(seed = TRUE, packages = "ctmm"), .progress = TRUE) future::plan(future::sequential) toc() pig_periods <- pig_periods %>% mutate(fit = map(results, "fit"), ud = map(results, "ud")) %>% dplyr::select(-pig_fit) # any pig-periods where the fit failed failed <- pig_periods %>% filter(map_lgl(ud, is.null)) if (nrow(failed) > 0) { warning("Fit failed for: ", paste(failed$name, failed$period, collapse = ", ")) } pig_periods <- pig_periods %>% filter(!map_lgl(ud, is.null)) saveRDS(pig_periods, file) beep(sound = 2) pig_periods } # the number of days of each pig in each period, including those that # are removed for having fewer than min_days period_days <- function(pigs_nested, period_fun) { pigs_nested %>% mutate(periods = map(telemetry, ~ split_telemetry(.x, period_fun))) %>% dplyr::select(name, periods) %>% unnest(periods) %>% dplyr::select(name, period, start, n_fixes, n_days) } # 50% and 95% contours (with CIs) of each pig-period as sf (in EPSG:3112) period_contours <- function(pig_periods, levels = contour_levels) { # periods ordered by when they start period_levels <- pig_periods %>% summarise(start = min(start), .by = period) %>% arrange(start) %>% pull(period) pig_periods %>% dplyr::select(name, period, ud) %>% crossing(level_ud = levels) %>% mutate(hr_sf = map2(ud, level_ud, ~ as.sf(.x, level.UD = .y, level = 0.95) %>% st_transform(crs = 3112))) %>% dplyr::select(name, period, level_ud, hr_sf) %>% # as.sf already has a 'name' column (e.g. "Betty 95% est"), so rename it mutate(hr_sf = map(hr_sf, ~ rename(.x, contour = name))) %>% unnest(hr_sf) %>% st_as_sf(crs = 3112) %>% mutate(ci = word(contour, -1), period = factor(period, levels = period_levels), area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(.)) / 1e6) %>% dplyr::select(name, period, level_ud, ci, area_km2) } # area of each pig in each period, with 95% CIs plot_period_areas <- function(hr_sf, title) { areas <- hr_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% pivot_wider(names_from = ci, values_from = area_km2) %>% mutate(level = paste0(level_ud * 100, "%")) dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.6) ggplot(areas, aes(x = period, y = est, colour = name, group = name)) + geom_line(position = dodge, alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.3) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = low, ymax = high), position = dodge, width = 0, alpha = 0.5) + geom_point(position = dodge, size = 1) + # mean across pigs stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "point", colour = "black", shape = 4, size = 3, stroke = 1) + scale_colour_viridis_d(guide = "none") + scale_y_continuous(expression("Area (km"^2*")")) + facet_wrap(~ level, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) + labs(title = title, subtitle = "Weighted AKDE with 95% CIs. Crosses are the mean across pigs", x = "") + theme_bw() } # leaflet map of the contour point estimates, with radio buttons to choose # the period, showing that period's (thinned) GPS fixes period_hr_map <- function(hr_sf, pts_sf, title) { hr_sf <- hr_sf %>% filter(ci == "est") %>% st_transform(crs = 4326) %>% mutate(popup = paste0("ID: ", name, "

This uses all of the data (`pig_all`) rather than the prototyping subset. ## Settings Pig-months with only a few days of data (e.g. when the collar was deployed or dropped off part-way through a month) will have artificially small areas, so they are removed. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # minimum number of days with fixes for a pig-month to be included min_days <- 20 # contour levels (50% core area and 95% home range) contour_levels <- c(0.5, 0.95) # set to a number to only fit the first n pig-months with ctmm (for testing), # or NA to fit them all n_test <- NA ``` ::: ## Monthly area through time The background shading shows the season of each month. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # season of each month (the most common season label of the fixes in that month) month_seasons <- pig_monthly %>% dplyr::select(month_date, data) %>% unnest(data) %>% count(month_date, season) %>% slice_max(n, by = month_date, with_ties = FALSE) %>% mutate(xmin = month_date, xmax = month_date %m+% months(1)) # areas are plotted at the middle of each month hr_monthly_area_est <- hr_monthly_mcp_area %>% mutate(level = paste0(level_ud * 100, "%"), method = factor(method, levels = "MCP"), month_mid = month_date + days(14)) hr_monthly_area_mean <- hr_monthly_area_est %>% summarise(area_km2 = mean(area_km2), .by = c(method, level, month_mid)) ggplot() + geom_rect(data = month_seasons, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = season), alpha = 0.15) + geom_line(data = hr_monthly_area_est, aes(x = month_mid, y = area_km2, colour = name), alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.3) + geom_point(data = hr_monthly_area_est, aes(x = month_mid, y = area_km2, colour = name), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.75) + # mean across pigs geom_line(data = hr_monthly_area_mean, aes(x = month_mid, y = area_km2), linewidth = 1) + scale_colour_viridis_d(guide = "none") + scale_fill_manual("Season", values = c("dry" = "orange", "wet" = "blue")) + scale_x_date("", date_breaks = "2 months", date_labels = "%b\n%Y") + scale_y_continuous(expression("Area (km"^2*")")) + coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE, ylim = c(0,20)) + facet_grid(method ~ level, scales = "free_y") + labs(title = "Monthly space use of each pig", subtitle = "Black line is the mean across pigs") + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](space_use_monthly-mcp_east_alligator_files/figure-pdf/unnamed-chunk-26-1.png){fig-pos='H'} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggsave(paste0(outputs_dir, "pigs_hr_monthly_area.png"), width = 150, height = 180, units = "mm", scale = 1.25, dpi = 600) ``` ::: ##
